title: Fix PK/FK icon layering and styling in SQLite schema tree
body:
PK/FK icon circles in the schema tree sidebar were rendering behind the vertical guide line, and had a mismatched background with a visible border ring.

## Changes

- **`sqlPlayground.css`**
  - `.sql-tree-column-icons`: add `position: relative; z-index: 1` so icon circles stack above the `::before` guide line
  - `.sql-tree-column-pk / .sql-tree-column-fk`: remove `border: 1px solid var(--border)`; change `background` from `var(--bg)` → `var(--bg2)` to match the sidebar pane background
